outcome.description: Observed compare-and-set result; only the Skill machine maps it to a next state.

headRef.description: New or already-current durable head for successful outcomes; otherwise null.

headSha256.description: Hash of the successful durable head; otherwise null.

writeApplied.description: Whether this invocation appended the immutable head.

reason.description: Single evidence-backed reason for the compare-and-set outcome.

evidenceRefs.description: Policy, redaction, authority, prior-head, and durable-write evidence used.
